caption:
Quick checklist before the holiday shopping rush. 🛍️

✔ Know your card's APR
✔ Know the due date
✔ Set autopay for at least the minimum
✔ Check your balance weekly

A 2-minute check now saves a headache in January. Check your own situation, as everyone's is different.

What's on your list?
